artifact:
Feature: Lab Management and Patient Profile Archiving

  Scenario: Lab In-charge views open lab-requests and updates status
    Given the Lab In-charge is logged into the system
    When the Lab In-charge views the open lab-requests
    Then the system displays a list of open lab-requests
    And the Lab In-charge updates the status to "Actual Sample Collection"
    Then the status of the lab-request is updated to "Actual Sample Collection"

  Scenario: Patient views Prescription and prints the invoice
    Given the Patient is logged into the system
    When the Patient views the Prescription
    Then the system displays the Prescription
    And the Patient prints the invoice
    Then the system generates and prints the invoice

  Scenario: Admin prints and emails the Prescription and Invoice
    Given the Admin is logged into the system
    When the Admin prints the Prescription and Invoice for a Patient
    Then the system generates and prints the Prescription and Invoice
    And the Admin emails the Prescription and Invoice to the Patient
    Then the system sends an email containing the Prescription and Invoice to the Patient

  Scenario Outline: Quarterly archiving of Patient Profiles and Consultation Requests
    Given the system is at the end of a quarter
    When the system performs the quarterly archiving process
    Then the system archives Patient Profiles that have not raised any Consultation Request for the last <years> years
    And the system archives Consultation Requests that are more than <years> years old

    Examples:
      | years |
      | 3     |
      | 4     |
      | 2     |

  Scenario: Archiving process handles edge cases
    Given the system is at the end of a quarter
    When the system performs the quarterly archiving process
    Then the system does not archive Patient Profiles that have raised Consultation Requests within the last 3 years
    And the system does not archive Consultation Requests that are 3 years old or less
